summary: R26.1 ASAP Pricing Engine V1 full E2E certification. All 5 test items PASS. (3) Three-way domestic ASAP consistency: /asap/quote and /pricing/quote (service_timing=asap) return IDENTICAL driver_charge/booking_fee/customer_total/engine_version for London→Guildford ~26.7mi LWB Van (£70/£10.50/£80.50, engine ASAP-V1.0). (4) International guardrail on GB→IE: both endpoints return requires_manual_review:true, route_class:'international', engine_version:'ASAP-V1.0', no driver_charge/customer_total. (5) Domestic /pricing/quote in asap mode returns numeric driver_charge/customer_total with engine_version=ASAP-V1.0. (1) Transport browser E2E: London→Guildford, all screen surfaces (booking summary panel, submit button, Stripe checkout amount) display the exact values returned by /api/asap/quote (driver=£39.00, fee=£5.85 @ 15%, total=£44.85, resolved_vehicle_key=car); /jobs POST 200, /bookings POST 200, redirected to Stripe checkout with £5.85 amount. (2) Recovery browser E2E: driver=£110.00, fee=£16.50 @ 15%, total=£126.50, resolved_vehicle_key=3_5t_recovery — matches R26_1_CERTIFICATION.md expected recovery numbers exactly. Stopped BEFORE submitting 4242 test card as instructed. Owner must complete payment to certify post-payment surfaces.

ui_bugs.issue: Component signature accepts `testID` prop only; AsapRequest.jsx passes `data-testid="asap-pickup"` and `data-testid="asap-dropoff"` which are silently dropped, leaving the two most critical form triggers without a stable test hook. Selectors had to fall back to placeholder text. Recommend renaming to `testID` in AsapRequest.jsx (lines 443, 464) or making AddressAutocomplete read both.

No vehicle picker exposed for Transport ASAP. With no weight and no requested_vehicle_key sent, the engine defaults to `car` (£39 min charge) instead of `LWB Van` (£70) that the R26 documentation assumes. Customer cannot express intent for a larger vehicle before quote. Recovery mode also does not offer a weight-class picker (3.5T / 7.5T Recovery) — engine defaults to `3_5t_recovery`. Not a screen-consistency bug (screens do faithfully reflect whatever the engine returns) but a UX gap vs the R26.1 spec's expected £70/£80.50 numbers.

Live /asap/quote response captured over the network arrives with `distance_miles: null` (though direct API POST returns 26.72). Root cause is the same `distance_miles` field being null in the frontend-triggered call; UI falls back to haversine 27 mi (approx). Pricing itself is unaffected (both requests hit the minimum-charge floor). Worth investigating why distance_miles isn't surfaced through the ASAP frontend path.

integration_issues.issue: /api/geo/autocomplete returns empty suggestions in preview because backend `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` in /app/backend/.env contains Cyrillic homoglyphs (А, В, Р) — 'АlzaSyC8r_5bVqkH6Yf2UUgВw3Fm9HSrFilZРKE'. Google API rejects it silently. The frontend fallback to manual entry does NOT surface a way to enter lat/lng, meaning the ASAP flow is effectively unusable in preview without either (a) 'Use my current location' (needs GPS grant), or (b) a working autocomplete key. Tests worked because we mocked /geo/autocomplete + /geo/details via Playwright route intercept.

action_items: R26.1 engine + guardrails are production-ready. Owner should now click the Stripe 4242 test card on both captured checkout URLs to certify post-payment surfaces (booking confirmation, /customer/booking/:id, admin, driver live offer, Mongo snapshot).
MEDIUM: Fix AddressAutocomplete data-testid drop bug — AsapRequest.jsx uses `data-testid` but component only reads `testID`. Rename props or make component accept both.

MEDIUM: Consider exposing a vehicle picker on the ASAP flow (Transport: LWB Van/Luton/3.5T; Recovery: 3.5T/7.5T). Currently defaults to smallest available vehicle, which surprised the R26 spec author (they expected £70 LWB but got £39 car).
LOW: Fix Google Maps API key in /app/backend/.env — contains Cyrillic homoglyphs (А, В, Р) making autocomplete unusable in preview. Fine in production if the browser JS key is different.
LOW: Investigate why /api/asap/quote returns distance_miles:null when called from the frontend (direct pytest call returns 26.72). Cosmetic — pricing is unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1428-1502 (POST /asap/quote): guardrail correctly short-circuits before route resolve and engine call. classify_route(None,None)→domestic_uk override preserves legacy contract. Audit-log insert wrapped in try/except so a broken audit collection can't fail the quote. All good.

server.py L1526-1580 (POST /pricing/quote asap branch): mirrors the same guardrail logic — perfectly consistent with /asap/quote. Both call the same calculate_asap_quote so item 3 consistency is baked in.
server.py L1503: three blank lines between endpoints — minor style.

AsapRequest.jsx L189-214: does NOT send pickup_country_code or dropoff_country_code to /asap/quote. That means the guardrail relies on classify_route(None,None)→domestic_uk fallback. If a UK customer ever books a GB→IE route via the UI, the guardrail would NOT fire because country codes are absent. RECOMMEND: frontend should send country_code from the AddressAutocomplete result (which does include country_code) to prevent silent quote of an international route.
AsapRequest.jsx L443/L464: `data-testid` prop passed to AddressAutocomplete is silently dropped — see UI bug above.

AddressAutocomplete review-mode form: `canCommit` accepts postcode+town without coords, but the ASAP quote endpoint requires non-zero coords. If a customer manually enters a postcode+town with no coords, `onSubmit` in AsapRequest correctly blocks with 'Please confirm your collection location' — safe.
